reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29. The Neutrl Accountable endpoint returned its latest verifiable type_split snapshot timestamped 1786618957520 (2026-08-13T11:02:37.520Z): total reserves $54,437,465.43, total supply $53,680,782.11, and net reserve excess $756,683.33. The six source buckets are Stablecoin $31,317,867.09, JLP $9,230,249.65, OTC Aggregate $9,803,139.04, Other $1,937,498.13, Protocol Owned Liquidity $2,145,062.40, and ETH $3,649.13. Percentages below are normalized to the source total and retain the adapter's type_split bucket names; the endpoint does not provide a same-date constituent or custody schedule.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable type_split categories and values from the latest verifiable Neutrl snapshot (source timestamp 2026-08-13), normalized to the reported reserve total
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The stablecoin bucket is not split by issuer in the configured type_split feed; JLP underlying positions, OTC counterparties and terms, and the Other and Protocol Owned Liquidity contents and custody remain undisclosed. ETH is identified but remains an external cryptoasset dependency.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The type_split feed identifies a stablecoin reserve value but does not provide current issuer-level constituents needed for tracked dependency links.
The dashboard names JLP but does not expose its current underlying position, valuation basis, or custody detail.
The dashboard reports an aggregate OTC category without identifying current counterparties, contracts, or settlement terms.
The dashboard does not disclose the asset classes or providers included in the Other category.
The dashboard names protocol-owned liquidity but does not expose pool identities, underlying assets, or custody details.
The ETH bucket is external cryptoasset collateral, not a tracked stablecoin dependency.
